requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, and ensure CMY bottle size supports >8,000 pages. Bottles must deliver spill-free reliability and integrate metal-foiled labyrinth with lid label. No change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanism.
requirements.Rationale: High page yield and spill-free design are required to meet market demand for efficiency, user convenience, and to compete with CISS competitors like Epson.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, Product Management, End Users, Factory
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modification of SA14 line, support for NOA-F, integration with IDS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must pass page yield tests (6K for Black, 6K for CMY, >8K for CMY bottle size), spill test, and reliability characterization.

requirements.Title: NOA-F Module with Metal-Foiled Labyrinth
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - F) with a metal-foiled labyrinth and lid label. NOA-F should be serviceable as a warranty part and be supported for end-of-life (EOL) replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, supports serviceability, and aligns with new warranty requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires factory line modification, IDS integration, and support for warranty logistics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F module must meet reliability and EOL criteria, be field-replaceable, and pass metal-foiled labyrinth validation.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design printer so that both PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F modules are customer-replaceable, improving serviceability and reducing downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience by minimizing service center visits and downtime, supporting PaaS and SMB models.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design changes for tool-less access and clear instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools, and replacement process is documented and tested for usability.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages, with serviceable ink maintenance parts post-80K life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports contractual service models and competitive positioning in SMB/Enterprise segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Services, SMB, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on paper path, ink system, and maintenance box reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates reliably up to 80,000 pages, with serviceable parts available for post-warranty support.

requirements.Title: Speed Specification: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard, 20 ppm for color, and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) printing.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive speed is necessary to meet market expectations for SMB and Enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on platform hardware, printhead, and firmware performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard and PDL modes during benchmark testing.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization with Increased Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Optimize product size to accommodate increased tank protrusion, including changes to input and output trays, while maintaining Reddington ID and no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Larger tanks are required for higher page yield; design must remain ergonomic and recognizable.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on finalized tank size and tray integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product fits within defined size envelope, trays operate without interference, and tank capacity is increased as specified.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are required for sales in regulated markets and to meet customer sustainability expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compliance with environmental design and documentation standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) for user interface and operation.
requirements.Rationale: Larger, color display enhances usability and supports advanced features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware support for the new display.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional, responsive, and passes usability tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and develop new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow, reliability, and integration with new tank sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on tank and carriage design, IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink system operates reliably with new tube routing; passes flow and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station to manage aerosols with spit platform changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and supports higher duty cycle with increased page life.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on tank and service station redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment meets safety and reliability standards; validated in testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new ink system configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on finalized ink system and carriage design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic and force validation tests with new weights and routing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path design to support increased page life up to 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Longer page life demands higher durability in paper handling components.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on materials selection and mechanical design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes 80,000-page endurance test without failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Box as Serviceable Part
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance box to be serviceable at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Supports post-warranty servicing and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on modular design of maintenance box and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service centers; replacement process is validated.

requirements.Title: Integration of SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: Integrate SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, new keyed bottles, and Magi/Nessie pigment inks into the platform, with 140ml K bottles and new CMY bottle sizes.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers improved performance, compatibility, and supports new page yield targets.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on supply chain readiness and IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All components are validated for compatibility and performance in system-level tests.

requirements.Title: IDS Make-Break and FI Connection Update
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS (Ink Delivery System) make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connections, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new bottle and tank designs, improves reliability and user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on new bottle and tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connections pass reliability, leak, and usability tests; SHAID is validated.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to ensure reliable operation with new tank and bottle designs.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents startup failures and ensures consistent print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on IDS hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management pass reliability and startup validation tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Tracking
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion tracking to align with updated page yield definitions and customer expectations.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality remains high across the extended duty cycle and new yield definitions.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on IDS, firmware, and consumables integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets defined standards throughout rated page life; depletion tracking is accurate.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU components in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and risk by reusing proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform design must be validated.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as intended in the new system without modification.

requirements.Title: Integration of Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for connectivity and feature support.
requirements.Rationale: Provides up-to-date wireless connectivity and firmware features.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware integration and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wireless connectivity passes performance and compatibility tests; firmware features are functional.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Hardware and Firmware Security
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with HP security standards and protects customer data.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware updates and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external security audits.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the new product to ensure safe transport and compliance with packaging standards.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces risk of transit damage and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on final product size and weight.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests; meets regulatory requirements.

requirements.Title: Solution and Services for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible business models and broadens market reach.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Services, Marketing, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and service integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business models and onboarding paths are functional and validated with customer pilots.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and SMB manageability features, with enterprise support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses key requirements for SMB and Enterprise customers, supporting managed print environments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, SMB, Enterprise IT, Services
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software, firmware, and network integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and manageability features are functional and validated in SMB/Enterprise environments.

requirements.Title: Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD Clients & Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Supports a wide range of deployment and management scenarios for all customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires driver and client software validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass installation and functionality tests.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform and Marconi-Hi Product
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform and Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID) for new development, integrating CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Accelerates development, reduces cost, and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation and minor customization for new features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform integration is successful; all new features are supported and validated.

requirements.Title: Business Priority: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constrain)
requirements.Description: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA life at 65,000 pages are least flexible constraints and must be met without compromise.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for market launch timing and performance reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on supply chain, manufacturing, and component reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA life is validated to 65,000 pages; schedule milestones are achieved as planned.

requirements.Title: Business Priority: Warranty Life of 80K Pages, 2 Years (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Warranty life of 80,000 pages or 2 years is a key business priority with some flexibility in optimization.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive landscape and customer expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on reliability testing and component selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are met; product passes 80,000-page and 2-year reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Business Priority: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K are flexible priorities that may be adjusted based on market or technical feedback.
requirements.Rationale: Provides optional upgrades or configurations for specific markets or segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on supply chain and market demand.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Optional configurations are documented and available if required.
